claims.text: rUv merged pull request #4239 into Ruflo's main branch on 17 October at 14:59 London time; Mondweep Chakravorty opened it at 23:02 the night before.
claims.quote: into Ruflo's main branch on 17 October at 14:59 London time

claims.text: The pull request adds one file, docs/integrations/sgit-memory-checkpoints.md, which documents how an Agent Behaviour Policy can govern Ruflo's memory and keep its checkpoints in an encrypted SGit vault.
claims.quote: which documents how an Agent Behaviour Policy can govern Ruflo's memory and keep its checkpoints in an encrypted SGit vault

claims.text: Of the 9,625 commits on Ruflo's main branch, this is the first to mention SGit or an ABP, and Mondweep's first commit there.
claims.quote: of the 9,625 commits on its main branch, this is the first to mention SGit or an ABP

value.unit: commits on Ruflo's main branch mentioning SGit or an ABP

claims.text: Two days earlier, at Agentic Engineering Live, the owner said the team was ready to sell this; now the method has a page inside the project it governs, written by someone outside the team.
claims.quote: Two days earlier, at Agentic Engineering Live, I said we were ready to sell this.

claims.text: mondweep/sgit-ruv-memory is a small MCP server, MIT-licensed, with five commits on 16 October, the last at 23:58.
claims.quote: is a small MCP server, MIT-licensed, with five commits on 16 October

claims.text: The adapter compiles an ABP into Ruflo's rule format, asks a pinned copy of Ruflo's own policy evaluator for a decision in enforce mode before each of its tools runs, and keeps each memory checkpoint in its own encrypted SGit vault.
claims.quote: asks a pinned copy of Ruflo's own policy evaluator for a decision in enforce mode before each of its tools runs

claims.text: Sixteen tests pass, by the author's own evidence.
claims.quote: Sixteen tests pass, by the author's own evidence.

claims.text: The pull request changed one new file, 83 lines added and none removed, in three commits over one hour on the evening of 16 October.
claims.quote: one new file, docs/integrations/sgit-memory-checkpoints.md, 83 lines added, none removed

claims.text: The second commit is the one that matters most to the owner: the first version documented the adapter; the second documents the ABP compiled into Ruflo's rules and enforced on every operation.
claims.quote: the second documents the ABP compiled into Ruflo's rules and enforced on every operation

claims.text: The description lists the evidence and the gaps in the same breath: semantic quality is not validated, and the change is documentation only with no runtime defaults or dependencies changed.
claims.quote: Semantic quality is NOT validated; the semantic report is partial.

claims.text: There was no formal approving review and no checks ran; the maintainer read the page and merged it, squashed into one commit, 332f22e, authored by Mondweep.
claims.quote: There was no formal approving review: the review requested from rUv still shows as pending on the page.

claims.text: The main reason the page was merged in under a day is that it does not oversell: with no automated gate, what got it in was the page being specific about what it claims.
claims.quote: I think this is the main reason it was merged in under a day. The page does not oversell.

claims.text: The page is the only file in a new docs/integrations folder on Ruflo's main branch and is not yet linked from Ruflo's docs index or its README.
claims.quote: It is not yet linked from Ruflo's docs index or its README

claims.text: The page pins everything it depends on: the code at 7607d72, SGit at source commit 5597526, and Ruflo's evaluator at 1882006, so anyone can reproduce it at those exact versions.
claims.quote: Anyone can reproduce what it describes, at those exact versions.

claims.text: Three capabilities on the page are proposed vocabulary extensions, not claims of existing upstream support; the fourth, read.record.history, already exists in the ABP.
claims.quote: Three capabilities below are proposed vocabulary extensions, not claims of existing upstream support.

claims.text: The page says the adapter policy does not restrict other shell or MCP tools, which is the gap the policy guards the door describes.
claims.quote: Adapter policy does not restrict other shell or MCP tools

claims.text: The three proposed capabilities are the first memory vocabulary the owner has seen proposed from outside the team, from a real integration, and the kind of feedback the ABP needs.
claims.quote: They are the first memory vocabulary I have seen proposed from outside our team, from a real integration

claims.text: The companion pull request in our own organisation adds the runnable example to ruv.sgit.ai, 3 commits, 35 files and 3,081 lines, and is still open with no reviews.
claims.quote: 3 commits, 35 files, 3,081 lines. It is still open, with no reviews.

value.unit: lines added in the companion pull request

claims.text: The order came out the other way round: Ruflo merged first, and the next merge is ours to make, after a review.
claims.quote: The next merge is ours to make, after a review.

claims.text: It is the first integration of the ABP and SGit into an agent framework that the owner knows of by someone outside the team, documented in that framework's own repository.
claims.quote: It is the first integration of the ABP and SGit into an agent framework that I know of by someone outside our team

claims.text: The page carries its evidence: pinned commits, tests, a reproducible run and its own limits, which is the evidence-first position in practice in someone else's repository.
claims.quote: Pinned commits, tests, a reproducible run, and its own limits.

claims.text: Not a code change to Ruflo: the merge adds documentation and Ruflo's runtime is unchanged, as the pull request says.
claims.quote: The merge adds documentation; Ruflo's runtime is unchanged, as the pull request says.

claims.text: Not a formal review: the maintainer merged it, and no approving review or check is recorded.
claims.quote: The maintainer merged it; no approving review or check is recorded.

claims.text: Not an endorsement of every detail: a merged page in a project's docs is not a statement by its maintainer about every claim in it.
claims.quote: A merged page in a project's docs is not a statement by its maintainer about every claim in it.

claims.text: First is from the commit history: no commit on Ruflo's main branch before it mentions SGit or an ABP; other discussions elsewhere are not counted.
claims.quote: No commit on Ruflo's main branch before it mentions SGit or an ABP; other discussions elsewhere are not counted.

claims.text: The code was read, not run, here; its tests and evidence are the author's.
claims.quote: Its tests and evidence are the author's.

claims.text: The video, SGit x Ruflo Working Proof of Concept by Mondweep Chakravorty, was analysed the same day and is published here with his agreement.
claims.quote: published here with his agreement
